$comment: Drop-in MCP server config for Claude Code and any client that reads .mcp.json. Requires the `axiom` binary on PATH — install with scripts/install.sh (Linux/macOS), scripts/install.ps1 (Windows), `cargo install --path axiom_engine_rs`, or `pip install axiom-engine`. To pin a trained checkpoint, append: "--checkpoint", "checkpoints/axiom_production_bpe.bin" — omit it to use the auto-bootstrapped model.
